  "pros": [
    "Intuitive drag-and-drop editor for visual design.",
    "Excellent templates and tools for showcasing fine art portfolios.",
    "Integrated e-commerce capabilities for selling artwork directly."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "E-commerce features felt less robust compared to previous experience with Shopify.",
    "Customization beyond basic templates could be restrictive without coding knowledge.",
    "Website loading speeds sometimes felt slower than desired for image-heavy content."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This artist found Wix to be a highly accessible platform for creating a visually stunning and professional online presence. The drag-and-drop interface and art-focused templates were particularly beneficial for displaying their portfolio. However, they noted that Wix's e-commerce functionality, while present, did not quite match the advanced capabilities they were accustomed to with Shopify."
